Coerce an HFData Object to an mlr3 Data Backend

as_data_backend.HFData.Rd

Converts an HFData object into an mlr3 DataBackend, triggering download and parsing of the underlying dataset if this has not already happened.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'HFData'
as_data_backend(data, ...)

Arguments

data

(HFData)
The HFData object to convert.

...

Additional arguments (currently unused).

Value

An mlr3 DataBackend.
